record.bible_text: The word<WH01697> of the LORD<WH03068> that came to Micah<WH04318> the Morasthite<WH04183> in the days<WH03117> of Jotham<WH03147>, Ahaz<WH0271>, <FI>and<Fi> Hezekiah<WH03169>, kings<WH04428> of Judah<WH03063>, which he saw<WH02372><WTH8804> concerning Samaria<WH08111> and Jerusalem<WH03389>.

Hear<WH08085><WTH8798>, all ye people<WH05971>; hearken<WH07181><WTH8685>, O earth<WH0776>, and all that therein<WH04393> is: and let the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069> be witness<WH05707> against you, the Lord<WH0136> from his holy<WH06944> temple<WH01964>. <RF>all ye...: Heb. ye people, all of them<Rf> <RF>all that...: Heb. the fulness thereof<Rf>

For, behold, the LORD<WH03068> cometh forth<WH03318><WTH8802> out of his place<WH04725>, and will come down<WH03381><WTH8804>, and tread<WH01869><WTH8804> upon the high places<WH01116> of the earth<WH0776>.

And the mountains<WH02022> shall be molten<WH04549><WTH8738> under him, and the valleys<WH06010> shall be cleft<WH01234><WTH8691>, as wax<WH01749> before<WH06440> the fire<WH0784>, <FI>and<Fi> as the waters<WH04325> <FI>that are<Fi> poured<WH05064><WTH8716> down a steep place<WH04174>. <RF>a steep...: Heb. a descent<Rf>

For the transgression<WH06588> of Jacob<WH03290> <FI>is<Fi> all this, and for the sins<WH02403> of the house<WH01004> of Israel<WH03478>. What <FI>is<Fi> the transgression<WH06588> of Jacob<WH03290>? <FI>is it<Fi> not Samaria<WH08111>? and what <FI>are<Fi> the high places<WH01116> of Judah<WH03063>? <FI>are they<Fi> not Jerusalem<WH03389>?

Therefore I will make<WH07760><WTH8804> Samaria<WH08111> as an heap<WH05856> of the field<WH07704>, <FI>and<Fi> as plantings<WH04302> of a vineyard<WH03754>: and I will pour down<WH05064><WTH8689> the stones<WH068> thereof into the valley<WH01516>, and I will discover<WH01540><WTH8762> the foundations<WH03247> thereof.

And all the graven images<WH06456> thereof shall be beaten to pieces<WH03807><WTH8714>, and all the hires<WH0868> thereof shall be burned<WH08313><WTH8735> with the fire<WH0784>, and all the idols<WH06091> thereof will I lay<WH07760><WTH8799> desolate<WH08077>: for she gathered<WH06908><WTH8765> <FI>it<Fi> of the hire<WH0868> of an harlot<WH02181><WTH8802>, and they shall return<WH07725><WTH8799> to the hire<WH0868> of an harlot<WH02181><WTH8802>.<CM>

Therefore I will wail<WH05594><WTH8799> and howl<WH03213><WTH8686>, I will go<WH03212><WTH8799> stripped<WH07758><WTH8675><WH07758> and naked<WH06174>: I will make<WH06213><WTH8799> a wailing<WH04553> like the dragons<WH08577>, and mourning<WH060> as the owls<WH01323><WH03284>. <RF>owls: Heb. daughters of the owl<Rf>

For her wound<WH04347> <FI>is<Fi> incurable<WH0605><WTH8803>; for it is come<WH0935><WTH8804> unto Judah<WH03063>; he is come<WH05060><WTH8804> unto the gate<WH08179> of my people<WH05971>, <FI>even<Fi> to Jerusalem<WH03389>. <RF>her...: or, she is grievously sick of her wounds<Rf>

Declare<WH05046><WTH8686> ye <FI>it<Fi> not at Gath<WH01661>, weep<WH01058><WTH8799> ye not at all<WH01058><WTH8800>: in the house of Aphrah<WH01036> roll<WH06428><WTH8690><WTH8675><WH06428><WTH8694> thyself in the dust<WH06083>. <RF>Aphrah: that is, Dust<Rf>

Pass ye away<WH05674><WTH8798>, thou inhabitant<WH03427><WTH8802> of Saphir<WH08208>, having thy shame<WH01322> naked<WH06181>: the inhabitant<WH03427><WTH8802> of Zaanan<WH06630> came not forth<WH03318><WTH8804> in the mourning<WH04553> of Bethezel<WH01018>; he shall receive<WH03947><WTH8799> of you his standing<WH05979>. <RF>thou...: or, thou that dwellest fairly<Rf> <RF>inhabitant: Heb. inhabitress<Rf> <RF>Zaanan: or, The country of flocks<Rf> <RF>Bethezel: or, A place near<Rf>

For the inhabitant<WH03427><WTH8802> of Maroth<WH04796> waited carefully<WH02342><WTH8804> for good<WH02896>: but evil<WH07451> came down<WH03381><WTH8804> from the LORD<WH03068> unto the gate<WH08179> of Jerusalem<WH03389>. <RF>inhabitant: Heb. inhabitress<Rf> <RF>waited...: or, was grieved<Rf>

O thou inhabitant<WH03427><WTH8802> of Lachish<WH03923>, bind<WH07573><WTH8798> the chariot<WH04818> to the swift beast<WH07409>: she <FI>is<Fi> the beginning<WH07225> of the sin<WH02403> to the daughter<WH01323> of Zion<WH06726>: for the transgressions<WH06588> of Israel<WH03478> were found<WH04672><WTH8738> in thee. <RF>inhabitant: Heb. inhabitress<Rf>

Therefore shalt thou give<WH05414><WTH8799> presents<WH07964> to Moreshethgath<WH04182>: the houses<WH01004> of Achzib<WH0392> <FI>shall be<Fi> a lie<WH0391> to the kings<WH04428> of Israel<WH03478>. <RF>to...: or, for Moreshethgath<Rf> <RF>Achzib: that is, A lie<Rf>

Yet will I bring<WH0935><WTH8686> an heir<WH03423><WTH8802> unto thee, O inhabitant<WH03427><WTH8802> of Mareshah<WH04762>: he shall come<WH0935><WTH8799> unto Adullam<WH05725> the glory<WH03519> of Israel<WH03478>. <RF>inhabitant: Heb. inhabitress<Rf> <RF>he...: or, the glory of Israel shall, etc<Rf>

Make thee bald<WH07139><WTH8798>, and poll<WH01494><WTH8798> thee for thy delicate<WH08588> children<WH01121>; enlarge<WH07337><WTH8685> thy baldness<WH07144> as the eagle<WH05404>; for they are gone into captivity<WH01540><WTH8804> from thee.<CM>
